professionalSummary: Owned the research operations programme for the credit workflow product for two years, serving as the named programme owner and holding the compliance sign‑off on each research plan under the delegation recorded with the compliance office.

Coordinated research logistics with compliance and the business units, recording responsibility boundaries for scheduling, consent and plan sign‑off.
